title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: sports lighting and screens
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Sports lighting and big screens
swms.task: Install the sports lighting on the roof edge and lift the big screens into place with the crane company's mobile crane, working from boom lifts more than 2 m above the ground.

facts.fallControl: Lights and screens are fixed from boom lifts with guardrails, with harnesses attached to the boom lift anchor points.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
facts.harnessSystem: Workers wear a full body harness with a restraint lanyard short enough that they cannot be thrown from the basket, clipped to the boom lift anchor point. Harnesses and lanyards are checked by the user before each use and inspected by a competent person every 6 months, recorded on the tag. Users are trained in working at heights and boom lift operation by a registered training organisation.

steps: Work with the crane crew during lifts
Install sports lighting and screens at height

rules.phrase: way to get them out safely if the crane fails
rules.source: Work Health and Safety Regulation 2011 (Qld) s 219, s 220, schedule 5
rules.quote: means are provided by which the persons being lifted or suspended can safely exit from the plant in the event of a failure in its normal operation
